links.outcome: Vertebral fracture detection sensitivity of AI versus radiologists and endocrinologists against expert-panel gold standard
links.effect: AI sensitivity 86.3% vs radiologists 50.0% and endocrinologists 68.8% (p<0.001 both); OR 6.30 (95% CI 2.90–13.58) vs radiologists, OR 2.85 (1.29–6.30) vs endocrinologists.
links.quote: Among 427 eligible CT scans, AI detected vertebral fractures with significantly higher sensitivity (86.3%) than radiologists (50.0%) or endocrinologists (68.8%) (p < 0.001 for both comparisons).

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic performance (sensitivity and odds of detection) of an AI platform for opportunistic vertebral fracture detection on routine CT scans compared to routine radiology reports and endocrinologist reviews, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice variation.
